findings.evidence: `rg -n "private theorem kernel_form_nonneg" code/TauCeti/Analysis/PositiveDefinite` reports identical private lemmas at `Basic.lean:249` and `FunctionKernel.lean:64`, both proving the same `conj (x i) * x j * F (v i + star (v j))` nonnegativity via `hF.sum_nonneg` and `rw [Complex.conj_conj]`.
findings.fix: Make the `Basic.lean` lemma reusable, for example a non-private/protected `IsPositiveDefinite.kernel_form_nonneg`, and have `FunctionKernel.lean` call it instead of repeating the proof.
findings.issue: `kernel_form_nonneg` is duplicated here and again in `FunctionKernel.lean:64`, so the function-to-kernel coefficient-conjugation proof now has two private copies to maintain.

summary: The changed proofs are mostly short kernel transports, but the same algebraic bridge proof is duplicated privately instead of being factored once and reused.
